literal: If one takes pain as pleasure, there will become one's own enemies desiring greatness.
translation: If a person accepts adversity as pleasure, they will attain a greatness that even their enemies will admire.
modern: துன்பத்தை இன்பமாக ஏற்றுக்கொண்டால், ஒருவனுடைய பகைவரும் விரும்பத்தக்க பெருமை அவனுக்கு உண்டாகும்.
explanation: This couplet explains how to overcome adversity by changing one's attitude towards it. If a person welcomes difficulties and pain (இன்னாமை) as if they were pleasures (இன்பம்), they develop an unshakeable strength. This attitude leads to a level of greatness and distinction (சிறப்பு) that even their enemies (ஒன்னார்) will look upon with admiration and desire to possess. By not being defeated by suffering, one wins the ultimate respect of all.
